Name: (Obsolete) Custom Gift Dialogue Utility
Author: purrplingcat
Description:
[b]NOTE[/b]: This mod doesn't add any new dialogue into game! It's only utillity for other modders and for players which want to play a mods add custom gift reaction dialogues requiring this mod.

With this tool installed you can create your own gift reaction dialogues with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] or with [i]IAssetEditor [/i]in SMAPI mods. Also this mod is required for mods which add their custom gift reactions to the game.

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/purrplingcat/StardewModsSolution/master/CustomGiftDialogue/static/requirements.png[/img]

[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]StardewModding API (SMAPI)[/url]
[*]A legal copy of [url=https://stardewvalley.net/]Stardew Valley[/url]
[/list]
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/purrplingcat/StardewModsSolution/master/CustomGiftDialogue/static/compatibility.png[/img]﻿

[list]
[*]Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5 (both singleplayer and multiplayer)
[/list][list]
[*]Compatible with most SMAPI mods and Content Patcher
[*]Compatible with JSON Assets
[/list]
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/purrplingcat/StardewModsSolution/master/CustomGiftDialogue/static/installation.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Install SMAPI
[*]Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7304]this mod from Nexusmods[/url] and unpack it to [code]<GameFolder>/Mods[/code]
[*]Install some mods which adds gift reaction dialogues (or create your own with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url])
[/list]
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/purrplingcat/StardewModsSolution/master/CustomGiftDialogue/static/create-gift-reaction-dialogues.png[/img]

You can create your own gift reaction dialogues. [b][url=https://github.com/purrplingcat/StardewModsSolution/tree/master/CustomGiftDialogue#create-gift-reaction-dialogues]See documentation[/url][/b].

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/purrplingcat/StardewModsSolution/master/CustomGiftDialogue/static/see-also.png[/img]﻿

Downloads.Description:
Just example content pack with custom gift reaction dialogues for Content Patcher.
Requires Content Patcher by Pathoschild.

Version 1.3.0 adds support for NPC villagers can give a gift to a farmer. See docs for more info.
Version 1.3.1 fixes null pointer error on game time update


Unpack this ZIP file into your game `Mods` directory.
